newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Ilanot Batucha opens underwriting unit.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Ilanot Batucha opens underwriting unit.

text.p: Ilanot Batucha, one of Israel's leading investment houses, said on Monday it is expanding its activities by establishing an underwriting subsidiary.
The company said in a statmenet that the move will allow it to join in the underwriting activity during the next wave of public share offerings.
Establishing an underwriting house requires equity capital of at least two million shekels, the firm said.
Ilanot Batucha was formed by the merger of two leading Israeli investment houses. The merger received final approval on June 25. The investment house has assets of over 10 billion shekels.
